ety.text: From Hebrew פֵּא (pê), from Proto-Semitic *pay- (“mouth”). Doublet of pi.

senses.d: The seventeenth letter of many Semitic alphabets/abjads (Phoenician, Aramaic, Hebrew פ, Syriac ܦ, and others; Arabic has the analog faa).
The name of the Cyrillic script letter П / п.

fr:pé.gl: The name of the Latin script letter P/p.
